skill.summary: Full Salesflare API operations skill for reading, searching, creating, and updating CRM data (accounts, contacts, opportunities, tasks, pipelines, users, tag...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added new unified CLI entry point: scripts/sf.py, replacing scripts/sf.
- Updated docs to reflect `sf.py` script usage (`python scripts/sf.py ...`).
- Smoke-test lifecycle coverage clarified: lifecycle writes/deletes operate only on records created by the same test run.
- Noted that secrets should remain in local environment and not be published.
- Documented account feed endpoint caveat and new endpoint support.
- Expanded and reorganized mutation safety and smoke-test instructions.
